description: Source code for the GLImageGLTexture class, which manages OpenGL textures and EGL images, including creation, export, and binding operations within the Chromium media GPU component.

classes.name: GLImageGLTexture
classes.description: A class that encapsulates an OpenGL texture backed by an EGL image, supporting creation from textures, exporting handles, and binding to texture targets.

methods.name: CreateFromTexture
methods.description: Creates a GLImageGLTexture instance from a given texture ID, size, and format.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the texture/image.

methods.name: BindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the EGL image to a specified OpenGL texture target.

methods.name: GetInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal OpenGL format corresponding to the buffer format.

methods.name: ExportHandle
methods.description: Exports a native pixmap handle with DMA-BUF file descriptors for sharing the image.

methods.name: InitializeFromTexture
methods.description: Initializes the EGL image from a given texture ID.
